fn ov_encode_type(stage:*OvStage, syntax:*RmdTypeSyntax, buffer:*OvText, depth:usize)->unit {
    if (*stage).failed { return; }
    if depth == 256usize {
        ov_error(stage, &(*syntax).loc, "overload type nesting exceeds 256");
        return;
    }
    var kind:u32 = (*syntax).kind;
    if kind <= RMD_T_UNIT {
        ov_text(stage, buffer, "b");
        ov_number(stage, buffer, kind as u64);
        return;
    }
    if kind == RMD_T_NAME {
        ov_text(stage, buffer, "n");
        ov_part(stage, buffer, (*(*syntax).name).text, (*(*syntax).name).size);
        return;
    }
    if kind == RMD_T_POINTER || kind == RMD_T_ARRAY {
        if kind == RMD_T_POINTER { ov_text(stage, buffer, "p"); }
        else { ov_text(stage, buffer, "a"); ov_number(stage, buffer, (*syntax).count); }
        ov_encode_type(stage, (*syntax).base, buffer, depth + 1usize);
        return;
    }
    if kind == RMD_T_FUNCTION {
        ov_text(stage, buffer, "f");
        ov_number(stage, buffer, (*syntax).param_count as u64);
        var index:usize = 0usize;
        while index < (*syntax).param_count && !(*stage).failed {
            ov_encode_type(stage, (*syntax).params[index], buffer, depth + 1usize);
            index = index + 1usize;
        }
        ov_text(stage, buffer, "r");
        ov_encode_type(stage, (*syntax).base, buffer, depth + 1usize);
        return;
    }
    var hooks:*OvHooks = (*stage).hooks;
    if hooks != null(*OvHooks) && (*hooks).type_key != null(fn(*OvStage,*RmdTypeSyntax,*OvText,usize,*u8)->bool) {
        ov_text(stage, buffer, "x");
        ov_number(stage, buffer, kind as u64);
        var errors:usize = (*(*stage).context).error_count;
        var handled:bool = (*hooks).type_key(stage, syntax, buffer, depth, (*hooks).user);
        if (*(*stage).context).error_count != errors { (*stage).failed = true; }
        if handled || (*stage).failed { return; }
    }
    ov_error(stage, &(*syntax).loc, "overload stage has no encoding for this type");
}

fn ov_type_key(stage:*OvStage, syntax:*RmdTypeSyntax)->*RmdName {
    if (*stage).failed { return null(*RmdName); }
    var found:*RmdName = rmd_map_get(&(*stage).type_keys, syntax as usize) as *RmdName;
    if found != null(*RmdName) { return found; }
    (*stage).scratch.size = 0usize;
    ov_encode_type(stage, syntax, &(*stage).scratch, 0usize);
    found = ov_intern(stage, (*stage).scratch.data, (*stage).scratch.size);
    if found != null(*RmdName) { ov_put(stage, &(*stage).type_keys, syntax as usize, found as *u8); }
    return found;
}

fn ov_same(stage:*OvStage, a:*RmdTypeSyntax, b:*RmdTypeSyntax)->bool {
    if a == null(*RmdTypeSyntax) || b == null(*RmdTypeSyntax) || (*stage).failed { return false; }
    var left:*RmdName = ov_type_key(stage, a);
    var right:*RmdName = ov_type_key(stage, b);
    return !(*stage).failed && left == right;
}

fn ov_parameters(stage:*OvStage, syntax:*RmdTypeSyntax)->*RmdName {
    (*stage).scratch.size = 0usize;
    ov_text(stage, &(*stage).scratch, "a");
    ov_number(stage, &(*stage).scratch, (*syntax).param_count as u64);
    var index:usize = 0usize;
    while index < (*syntax).param_count && !(*stage).failed {
        ov_encode_type(stage, (*syntax).params[index], &(*stage).scratch, 0usize);
        index = index + 1usize;
    }
    return ov_intern(stage, (*stage).scratch.data, (*stage).scratch.size);
}

fn ov_function_syntax(stage:*OvStage, declaration:*RmdDecl)->*RmdTypeSyntax {
    var syntax:*RmdTypeSyntax = ov_type(stage, RMD_T_FUNCTION, &(*declaration).loc);
    if syntax == null(*RmdTypeSyntax) { return syntax; }
    (*syntax).base = (*declaration).syntax_type;
    (*syntax).param_count = (*declaration).param_count;
    (*syntax).params = ov_alloc(stage, (*syntax).param_count * sizeof(*RmdTypeSyntax), alignof(*RmdTypeSyntax)) as **RmdTypeSyntax;
    if (*stage).failed { return null(*RmdTypeSyntax); }
    var index:usize = 0usize;
    var parameter:*RmdParam = (*declaration).params;
    while parameter != null(*RmdParam) {
        (*syntax).params[index] = (*parameter).syntax_type;
        parameter = (*parameter).next;
        index = index + 1usize;
    }
    return syntax;
}

fn ov_select(stage:*OvStage, group:*OvGlobal, syntax:*RmdTypeSyntax, parameters_only:bool, loc:*RmdLoc)->*OvFunction {
    if (*stage).failed { return null(*OvFunction); }
    if group == null(*OvGlobal) || (*group).first == null(*OvFunction) || (*syntax).kind != RMD_T_FUNCTION {
        ov_error(stage, loc, "overload selection requires a function name and function type");
        return null(*OvFunction);
    }
    var key:*RmdName = ov_parameters(stage, syntax);
    if (*stage).failed { return null(*OvFunction); }
    var found:*OvFunction = rmd_map_get(&(*group).signatures, key as usize) as *OvFunction;
    if found == null(*OvFunction) {
        ov_error(stage, loc, "no overload matches the exact parameter types");
        return null(*OvFunction);
    }
    if !parameters_only && !ov_same(stage, (*(*found).syntax).base, (*syntax).base) {
        ov_error(stage, loc, "overload function value result type does not match");
        return null(*OvFunction);
    }
    return found;
}
